cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: Put It Back Quietly
cards.instruction: Return something you misplaced, used, or damaged without revealing why it needed restoring.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Your umbrella is back in the stand. Handle up, please; we store it so you can take it straight to work.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Why is it wet? It hasn't rained.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Routine cleaning. The fabric needs rinsing before the handle is dried; those are separate jobs.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then we remove debris before closing it. Please hold the stand; I'll rinse it again and put it back correctly this time.

reason: Use precise storage and cleaning corrections as A cover for restoring the umbrella, with the incriminating pondweed becoming another maintenance step rather than a confession.
